catalog.interpretation: Empty fallback page is consistent with unstaged catalog data; emptiness alone is not a compatibility failure.

limits: Icon Catalog initial rendering and bgicons zero exit do not qualify populated pages, actions or desktop icons.
System catalog page data is not staged; the original defaults name the dummy page Blank. No claim that page discovery succeeds.
Ordinary mode retains TYPE_STATUS=3, no terminal/handoff/marker, and XWD BadDrawable during bounded cleanup; its frame is not published. CI shell succeeds; startup repeatability is not established.
Per-PID captures contain first/last 4000 lines, overlap, and may truncate records; lists are observations, not event counts.
Both fm launches end in SIGSEGV after pipe and sgikopt ENOSYS; this sequence does not prove the sole crash cause.
Earlier waitsys(options=3) failure remains unqualified; these captures do not establish its resolution.
fmserv, artwork, filetype rules, catalog pages and delayed services remain unqualified.
Session saving is disabled; no general pthread, normal-exit, Newport or physical-hardware claims.
